user.title: Connect your fil pilote interface
user.description: Choose two different on/off relay entities and a room temperature sensor. Relay order must match your interface wiring.

settings.title: Thermostat settings
settings.description: Temperatures and tolerances are in °C. Leave startup overrides empty to restore the last state. Away sends frost protection; Sleep sends stop. Sensor timeout is in seconds and checked every minute.

error.same_relays: S1 and S2 must be different entities.
error.invalid_settings: Check the temperature range and target. Tolerances must be non-negative, and at least one must be greater than zero.

abort.already_configured: One or both relays are already used by a fil pilote thermostat.
